Choices save automatically. Screen sharing starts only after you allow it.
Shared with Camera and screen translation.
Scroll and tap the app underneath. The floating handle stays available.
Keep a small handle on screen; open it for all controls.

Use Fewer refreshes for animated pages or blinking cursors. Small changes reacts to smaller text updates.
